sourceRefs.locator: p. 39, introduction and fig. 1 with caption: discovery by A. Quinquin, recovery by the parish chaplain, cemetery and position of the horse pits in the Saint-Brice neighbourhood.
pp. 383–384, “The Franks and northern Gaul”: grave across the river from the fortifications, dress fastener, military symbolism, arms, ring and three horse pits.

summary.de: Gräberfeld am rechten Ufer der Schelde gegenüber der spätantiken Befestigung. Die spätere Kirche Saint-Brice dient der Orientierung.
summary.en: Cemetery on the right bank of the Scheldt, opposite the late Roman fortifications. The later church of Saint-Brice provides a landmark.
